title: decodeJSON uses DisallowUnknownFields, rejecting otherwise-valid payloads
evidence: handler.go:135 dec.DisallowUnknownFields() — a POST/PUT with any extra JSON key returns 400 even when title/author are valid
suggestion: Only reject on genuinely malformed input, or document the strict-schema behavior

title: PUT requires full body (no partial update)
evidence: handler.go:88 updateBook calls b.validate() then overwrites all columns — a PUT omitting title/author is 400, and year/isbn default to zero if omitted
suggestion: Acceptable for spec; note that this is full-replace semantics, not PATCH

title: itoa helper lives in non-test file but is only used by tests
evidence: util.go:5 func itoa is referenced only from handler_test.go
suggestion: Move to a _test.go file or inline strconv; cosmetic only
